integrity: The algebraic proof is complete over arbitrary fields; finite checks are supplementary and do not certify an infinite claim.
scientific_limitations: Exact divisor spectrum is proved for the explicitly defined cyclic-algebra-plus-annihilator family; it does not classify arbitrary degenerate evolution algebras. The originality assessment does not establish independent priority.
title: Complete divisor spectra of graph balance under annihilator shifts in cyclic evolution algebras
